def sha(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path,'rb') as f:
        for data in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''): h.update(data)
    return h.hexdigest()


def sanitize(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict): return {str(k):sanitize(v) for k,v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list,tuple,np.ndarray)): return [sanitize(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, (bytes,np.bytes_)): return value.decode('utf-8','replace')
    if isinstance(value, (float,np.floating)): return float(value) if np.isfinite(value) else None
    if isinstance(value, (int,np.integer)): return int(value)
    if isinstance(value, np.bool_): return bool(value)
    return value


def clean(probe):
    p=init_param(1)
    r={k:0 for k in structure.df1a_type}
    r.update(UUID='synthetic-80ns-'+probe,Timestamp=1723180000.,HV_C=-2500.,HV_G=0.,Tof_1=80.)
    for d in ('X','Y'):
        C=float(p[f'{probe.upper()}_{d}_SUM'])
        delta=-float(p[f'{probe.upper()}_B{d}'])/float(p[f'{probe.upper()}_K{d}'])
        r[f'T{d}_1s']=(C+delta)/2
        r[f'T{d}_2s']=(C-delta)/2
        for edge in ('1','2'): r[f'T{d}_{edge}e']=r[f'T{d}_{edge}s']+80.
    return pd.DataFrame([r])


def run(frame,probe,method,shim):
    if shim:
        legacy.ns_2_xy=lambda df,flag,params,prob:params['ns_2_xy'](df,flag,prob)
    else:
        legacy.__dict__.pop('ns_2_xy',None)
    before=frame.copy(deep=True)
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
        warnings.simplefilter('always')
        try:
            repaired=legacy.l1a_2_l1b(frame,init_param(1),probe,method)
            l2=legacy.l1_2_l2(repaired,params=init_param(1),prob=probe)
            selected=[c for c in ('Type','Process_Mask','Tofs','Tofe','start_valid','end_valid','TX_1s','TX_2s','TX_1e','TX_2e','TY_1s','TY_2s','TY_1e','TY_2e') if c in repaired]
            result={'status':'returned','rows':len(repaired),'input_unchanged':frame.equals(before),
                    'finite_Tofs':int(np.isfinite(repaired['Tofs']).sum()),
                    'type_counts':repaired['Type'].value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict(),
                    'L2_finite_energy':int(np.isfinite(l2['Energy']).sum()),
                    'L2_nonpositive_axis_tof':int(((l2['Tof_X']<=0)|(l2['Tof_Y']<=0)).sum()),
                    'first_rows_repaired':repaired[selected].head(3).to_dict('records'),
                    'first_rows_L2':l2[['Tof_X','Tof_Y','Tof','Spec','Energy']].head(3).to_dict('records')}
        except Exception as ex:
            result={'status':'error','exception':type(ex).__name__,'message':str(ex),'input_unchanged':frame.equals(before)}
        result['warnings']=sorted(set(str(w.message) for w in caught))[:5]
    return sanitize(result)

cases=[]
for probe in ('a','b'):
    base=clean(probe)
    for name in ('clean_80ns','missing_TX_1e','rollover_80ns'):
        f=base.copy(deep=True)
        if name=='missing_TX_1e': f.loc[:,'TX_1e']=0.
        if name=='rollover_80ns':
            for d in ('X','Y'):
                for edge in ('1','2'):
                    f[f'T{d}_{edge}s']+=600.
                    f[f'T{d}_{edge}e']=(f[f'T{d}_{edge}e']+600.)%663.552
        cs={'name':name,'probe':probe,'input':sanitize(f.to_dict('records')),
            'reachable_from_production_L1A':bool((f[[f'T{d}_{e}{s}' for d in 'XY' for e in '12' for s in 'se']]!=0).all(axis=None)),
            'legacy_unmodified':{},'legacy_name_shim_only':{}}
        for m in (1,2):
            cs['legacy_unmodified'][m]=run(f,probe,m,False)
            cs['legacy_name_shim_only'][m]=run(f,probe,m,True)
        cases.append(cs)
